db:section.db:title: Test Cases
db:section.db:para: This test covers multiple scenarios for QDoc's qualified name handling:

db:listitem.db:para: DerivedType - Uses import TestModule as TM syntax (2 segments).
Module aliased types: Models.ListModel with import QtQml.Models as Models.
Mixed import patterns: Both direct and aliased imports in same file.
The inheritance should show BaseType as the parent.
Code examples should link to BaseType::doSomething().
Compare aliased vs non-aliased qualified type linking behavior.
QML qualified names with "." should be marked up completely: TM.BaseType
Module qualified types should be marked up completely: Models.ListModel
Property names should be marked up completely: Layout.preferredSize
Types that can be resolved should get clickable links: TM.BaseType
Multi-segment names should be handled correctly regardless of length
